t: An Arduino board that sends small sensor messages over long-range LoRa radio.
steps: Buy the board from the Arduino store, SparkFun, or a distributor such as DigiKey.
Check your local radio rules and pick your region's licence-free band.
Attach the included antenna before you power the board.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the Arduino SAMD board package.
Install the MKRWAN library and run the FirstConfiguration example.
Create a free account on The Things Network and register the board.
Follow the Arduino tutorial to send your first message.
meta: Wild Open. From $46. A few stores.
